name: Strands Box
description: Sandboxes agent programs with OS-level file, program, and network limits plus Dogwood policy rules enforced across shell, Python, HTTP egress, and MCP calls; macOS preview.

skills.name: File, Program, and Network Restrictions
skills.description: Limits the agent's direct access with OS-enforced grants configured in box.toml.

skills.name: Semantic and Temporal Policies
skills.description: Evaluates Dogwood permit and forbid rules that can depend on arguments, earlier actions, and elapsed time.

skills.name: Request and Tool-Call Checks
skills.description: Checks outbound connections, HTTP methods and paths, and configured MCP tool calls against policy.

skills.name: Credential Injection
skills.description: Authenticates permitted requests with API credentials or AWS SigV4 so the agent never sees secrets.

skills.name: Decision Records
skills.description: Records each policy decision as OTLP JSON for audit.
